snippet.title: PUBG | Patch Report #28.1 - New Feature Co-op Climb, RONDO New Electric Vehicle, Spring Fest 2024
snippet.description:
Hop into an electrifying adventure in Rondo with Update 28.1, featuring our first-ever electric vehicle, PICO BUS⚡🚌
Prepare to show off your teamwork skills with Co-op Climb updates, and don't miss out on the festivities of our annual Spring Fest 2024.

#PUBG #BATTLEGROUNDS
